name: sensei_spawn_target_exists
description: Spawn referencing a declared agent compiles cleanly
input:
agent specialist
  memory
    topic: Text
  on start
    say "Specialist ready"

  if stuck for 3 turns
    escalate to human

agent sensei
  on deep_dive(topic: Text)
    child = spawn specialist as "specialist_{topic}"
    say "Spawned specialist."

  if stuck for 3 turns
    escalate to human
